source_caption_text:
When bro asks me to play some jazz and I play this 😭🔥

I take a drive with bro and he tells me to play jazz music, so I play “Droppin’ Seeds.” The second Lil Wayne comes in over Tyler, The Creator’s smooth, brass-heavy production, the whole car instantly feels like a different kind of listening session.

Wayne’s verse is packed with clever wordplay and effortless flows, while the warm horns give the track that laid-back jazz-inspired feel. It might only be a little over a minute long, but Wayne manages to make every second count.

Bro might have asked for jazz, but this is probably not what he had in mind. “Droppin’ Seeds” is the perfect song to play when you want to catch someone completely off guard while still giving them something genuinely fire to listen to.

#lilwayne #rap #meme
